title: Prove sharp trace-zero E7 support twelve (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Every nonzero rational trace-zero quadratic on the seven-dimensional orthogonal complement of an E8 root has at least twelve nonzero root-line evaluations. A diagonal quadratic attains twelve. Claim type: scoped mathematical proof with an exact finite certificate.

```text
trace-zero quadratic
  -> zero sum on all 135 orthogonal frames
  -> primitive integer evaluations reduced modulo two
  -> nonzero vector in a binary [63,27,12] frame code
  -> support at least twelve
```

The finite certificate reconstructs the 135-by-63 frame-incidence matrix, proves binary rank 36, constructs a complete 27-vector kernel basis, and exhausts all 134,217,727 nonzero vectors. Their minimum Hamming weight is twelve. The written proof supplies the rational reduction, injectivity of quadratic evaluation, attainment, and transport to every E8 root.

This supplies the trace-zero replacement for statement (2) in [the released handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1502#discussioncomment-19145642). The unrestricted support-eleven case already follows from DreamingOfClouds #595/#3045 and DaysSky #897 and is credited to them. It is not claimed as new. The separate arbitrary-deletion extension statement remains open.

Only `research/e7-quadratic-support/` is added. The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit the immediate handoff, Andrey Mas #1560, Josie Elliston #1668/#1650/#1616, Aaron Wang #1649, and the retained Brett Halligan / themilkman216 / DreamingOfClouds E8 lineage. No predecessor census is replayed as the deliverable.

## Evidence

- Before: the handoff's unrestricted twelve-line auxiliary statement permits a known eleven-line product support; a trace-zero replacement was unproved there.
- After: complete binary enumeration proves minimum twelve, and a rational trace-zero quadratic attains it. The verifier checks all 135 literal frame sums, quadratic injectivity identities, the 120-root orbit, and 92 rejecting omission/basis controls.
- Both registered warning-strict local modes pass on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. Single-run CI-budget timings were 10.85 seconds normal and 10.60 seconds optimized; each registered timeout is 180 seconds.
- Package metadata/pins, registered replay, committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export integrity and optimized read-only Git-free replay pass at `0092f8010fed137b66c43c503cf11eb377fe6ecd`.

Exact commands, from the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/e7-quadratic-support/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/e7-quadratic-support/verify.py

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check /absolute/scratch/package.tar
```

Replace the local interpreter path with another CPython 3.12 installation as needed. Direct replay prints `PASS_E7_TRACE_ZERO_SUPPORT` and generated hashes of all five source files. The exported direct replay needs no Git or predecessor imports. Sources are pinned to canonical base `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`; refresh through `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf` found unchanged task guidance and no matching trace-zero result. The scientific source baseline is deliberately retained.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The exact binary minimum is established by exhaustive finite computation. The rational implication is a written proof, not formal proof-kernel verification. This package does not prove the arbitrary-deletion quadratic extension or the complete seven-deletion rigidity shortcut. Equality classification is not attempted. Native realization, physical supplier admission, selected cold replay, Lean and the complete multiplication theorem are outside scope and were not run. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Prove or refute the handoff's extension from every live-frame zero-sum function on P112 minus at most seven lines to an ambient trace-zero quadratic, keeping arbitrary-deletion quantifiers.
- Classify the rational trace-zero quadratics attaining twelve by examining quadratic kernels on the weight-twelve supports. This is separate from the proved minimum.

## Related open work

- #897 classifies E7 covers by hyperplane flats and records the 52-line best pair; it covers the unrestricted support-eleven case, whereas this result proves the trace-zero minimum twelve over all rational quadratics.
- #3045 records an E7 support-pair intersection of size eleven for non-dense fitting bounds; its unrestricted product case has different hypotheses from the trace-zero theorem.
- #4090 accelerates a P112 ten-deletion span census; it does not establish this E7 quadratic-support lemma, and its census was not replayed here.

The completion refresh of this account's open PRs created since the [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19146102) found #5238 and #5237. The other submission, #5237, certifies a four-plane COPY identity under a different tariff; it does not study the E7 trace-zero support quantity. No competing account submission or shared-number disagreement was found, and no extra predecessor computations were run.

Run metadata confirms completed status, success and the matching head SHA. Registered replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized VERIFY.json commands.

All local checks listed above also passed. Hosted replay certifies execution of the finite census and controls; independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed. The unrun obligations listed above remain outside this contribution.

Five new package files; existing research packages and the selected frontier are unchanged.
